ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_DATES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE validate_dates ( eff_date in date,
 term_date in date,
 from_where in varchar2 ) IS
 chp_sysdate DATE; 
 
begin

 if eff_date is null then
 show_error('5002');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
 
 IF :GLOBAL.tz_enabled = 'Y' THEN
 chp_sysdate := Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset, SYSDATE);
 ELSE
 chp_sysdate := SYSDATE;
 END IF; 
 
 if from_where = 'E' then
 if trunc(eff_date) < trunc(chp_sysdate) then
 show_error('5003');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
 if term_date is not null and trunc(term_date) < trunc(eff_date) then
 show_error('5004');
 check_package_failure; 
 end if;
 end if;
 
 if from_where = 'T' and term_date is not null then
 if trunc(term_date) < trunc(eff_date) then
 show_error('5004');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
 if trunc(term_date) < trunc(chp_sysdate) then
 show_error('3115');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 --
end validate_dates;

ProgramUnit.Name: DUP_CHECK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE dup_check IS
 check_dup number;
 temp number;

BEGIN
 :global.frm_status:='S';
 
/* Check in the database */

 select count(*) into temp from valid_hh_answers where
 question_code= :valid_hh_answers.question_code and answer_code=:valid_hh_answers.answer_code;

 if temp > 0 then
 show_error('16106');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;

/* check in the buffer */

 
 if nvl(:global.question_code,' ') != nvl(:valid_hh_answers.question_code,' ') or
 nvl(:global.answer_code,' ') != nvl(:valid_hh_answers.question_code,' ') then
 
 check_insert_rg('answer_rg0','C10C05',:global.question_code||','
 ||:global.answer_code||',','D',check_dup); 
 end if;

 check_insert_rg('answer_rg0','C10C05',:valid_hh_answers.question_code||','
 ||:valid_hh_answers.answer_code||',','C',check_dup);

 if check_dup = 1 then
 show_error('16106');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 check_insert_rg('answer_rg0','C10C05',:valid_hh_answers.question_code||','
 ||:valid_hh_answers.answer_code||',','U',check_dup);
 
 end if;

END;

PROCEDURE retrieve_data IS
chk boolean;
begin
go_block('valid_hh_answers');
clear_block(no_validate);
if :ctrl_blk_1.s_search_for is not null
 then

 question_code = :ctrl_blk_1.s_question_code');

 'upper(answer_desc) like ''%''||upper(:ctrl_blk_1.s_search_for)||''%''');

 'question_code = :ctrl_blk_1.s_question_code');
 end if;
 
end if;
go_block('valid_hh_answers');
execute_query;
set_block_property('valid_hh_answers',DEFAULT_WHERE,'');
go_block('valid_hh_answers');

end;
